items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution. Reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; the aggregate row is not site-attributable, so site-attributed commission is $0 without proving zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are unknown because revenue and cost periods do not align. AI-cost records also conflict: $881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls. Infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are absent or incomplete. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation; retain other opportunities as deferred backlog.

Minimum measurement required before financial claims: period-aligned site-attributable revenue with verified tracking IDs; ordered and shipped status; AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment costs; approved budget and commitments; and a defined learning outcome with incremental cost. Do not use impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, ordered items, performance scores, or AI usage as financial returns without attributable revenue or documented cost savings.
